jobs.description: Verantwortung für die technische Infrastruktur Als Technischer Leiter im Hotel in Ettlingen steuerst du den gesamten Betrieb und die Instandhaltung der gebäudetechnischen Anlagen. Du koordinierst externe Dienstleister, überwachst die Einhaltung aller Sicherheits- und Umweltstandards und verantwortest das technische Budget sowie anfallende Reparaturen im Haus. Deine ersten Monate im Hotel Du wirst dich in die bestehenden technischen Systeme einarbeiten, die Abläufe im täglichen Hotelbetrieb kennenlernen und erste Instandhaltungsprojekte eigenverantwortlich steuern. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Team vor Ort zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass alle technischen Einrichtungen reibungslos funktionieren. Das bringst du mit Ausbildung im technischen Bereich, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Gebäude-, Versorgungs- oder Sicherheitstechnik Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren technischen Führungsposition, vorzugsweise in der Hotellerie oder im Facility Management Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Hands-on-Mentalität bei der Störungsbeseitigung Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse für die Kommunikation im Team und mit Dienstleistern Extras und Vergünstigungen Dich erwartet eine unbefristete Anstellung bei der Radisson Hotel Group mit 40 Wochenstunden und 24 Urlaubstagen im Jahr. Nutze Angebote zur beruflichen Bildung, profitiere von Mentoring und erhalte Vergünstigungen sowie Mitarbeiterrabatte. Zudem stehen dir kostenlose Getränke und ein kostenloser Parkplatz zur Verfügung. Vergütung Das jährliche Gehalt für diese Position liegt zwischen EUR 52,000 und 66,000. Dein Start in Ettlingen Wenn du diesen Bereich mitgestalten möchtest und die genannten Anforderungen erfüllst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung über die Plattform. Die Probezeit beträgt sechs Monate. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Optimisation Team
jobs.description: Role - Software Engineer - Optimisation Team Company - iwell - Harmonizing Clean Energy Location - Utrecht About iwell At iwell, we are all about reinforcing energy security. We help European businesses become more energy independent. With growing regulations, extreme price volatility and rising grid issues, they need to be resilient. It is time to take charge and think ahead. We deliver energy management solutions that ensure that businesses are always in control of their energy. Our in-house developed EMS and modular battery storage drive profit through sustainability, making businesses future-proof. We are a fast-growing international team of bold, talented individuals. From engineers and software developers to creative thinkers and customer-focused business developers. No matter what your strong suit is, we always are looking for people who are determined to make a positive impact. The Role The Optimisation team builds the Python applications that decide what our customers' energy assets should do, and when. Batteries, EV fleets, solar and grid connections all come together in our optimiser, and the team turns prices, forecasts and constraints into schedules and decisions that run in production every day. Much of this work has an operations-research flavour, and the problems rarely arrive neatly defined.. They arrive as a customer who needs their vans charged by 6:00 at the lowest cost or a battery whose value depends on the hour. We're looking for someone who is comfortable across that whole path: understanding the real-world problem, shaping it into something a computer can solve, and shipping and operating the result. You don't need to be an OR specialist. You do need to be a strong Python engineer who enjoys messy, concrete problems. Success in this role means being able to: Take a loosely defined operational problem and turn it into working, maintainable production code. jobs.title: Founding Research Engineer or Research Scientist
jobs.description: About Grubel Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. Legal matters require specialized expertise, and each one involves its own facts, practices, parties, and institutions. General-purpose AI applies the same system to every legal matter, varying only what goes into a limited context window. To meet the depth and diversity of legal work, we let every matter build its own AI: engineer the right data for the matter, adapt the model and agent to it, and track what improves. We combine the three into a matter-specific improvement loop that runs until the system delivers what the matter demands. Grubel was founded in 2026 by Moritz Hardt, director at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and formerly a UC Berkeley professor and Google Brain researcher; and Reinhard Heckel, professor of machine learning at the Technical University of Munich, on leave to build Grubel. The founding team includes engineers with PhDs in computer science and experience in foundation-model pretraining at Mistral and legal AI research at Thomson Reuters. The lab has offices in Munich and Tübingen. Point Nine led an oversubscribed pre-seed funding round with backing from leading AI researchers and founders, including Jeff Dean, Chris Ré, Ion Stoica, and Harvey co-founders Gabe Pereyra and Winston Weinberg. About the role We are looking for a Founding Research Engineer or Research Scientist to develop the methods and systems that make matter-specific AI possible. You will work on data curation, agent environment design, model adaptation, training, and evaluation. We do not draw a sharp boundary between research and engineering: everyone contributes substantial code, owns experiments end-to-end, builds systems, and helps turn successful methods into products. Research is empirical and engineering intensive. You will work directly with Grubel’s founders, engineers, legal experts, and enterprise partners. As an early member of the team, yo

jobs.title: Eerste lijns system engineer
jobs.description: IT Medewerker – Eerste Lijns Service Engineer Ben jij die IT-held die energie krijgt van het helpen van mensen, houdt van virtuele omgevingen en SaaS-oplossingen, en een passie heeft voor techniek? Dan zouden we zomaar eens een match kunnen zijn. Wie zoeken we? We zijn op zoek naar een Eerste Lijns Service Engineer / Servicedesk Medewerker die klanten op een vriendelijke én deskundige manier verder helpt. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt bij IT-vragen of problemen . Zo weet je bijvoorbeeld wat het verschil is tussen een TAC en TAC 2 LAN netwerk of je kan rechten correct toewijzen in SharePoint. Je registreert en bewaakt meldingen in het systeem en zorgt voor een tijdige opvolging. Daarnaast weet precies hoe je iemand geruststelt, duidelijk communiceert en snel tot de kern van het probleem komt. Tot slot wordt je soms ook betrokken bij installatie van hardware en software migraties. Een diverse en uitdagende functie dus. Of je nu net van school komt of al wat meters hebt gemaakt in de IT: we horen graag van je. Wie zijn wij? Welkom bij Progression IT . Wij zijn een hecht en ambitieus IT-bedrijf uit Terneuzen, Zeeland. Al sinds 2005 helpen we onze klanten met slimme, veilige en toekomstgerichte IT-oplossingen. We doen dat met een enthousiast team van 25 collega’s – stuk voor stuk vakmensen met hart voor hun werk én voor elkaar. Onze focus ligt op cloud- en hybride omgevingen. We werken met moderne tools en technologieën en zijn ISO27001-gecertificeerd. Dat betekent dat veiligheid bij ons geen bijzaak is, maar standaard in alles wat we doen. En minstens zo belangrijk: naast hard werken, vinden we het ook belangrijk om lol te hebben. Zo lunchen we dagelijks samen (op kosten van de baas), ligt er altijd vers fruit klaar, en sporten we wekelijks onder begeleiding van een personal trainer. Een of twee keer per jaar trekken we eropuit voor een teamuitje – gewoon, omdat het gezellig is. Wat ga je doen? 🔹 Klanten telefonisch en op afstand ondersteunen (±70%) 🔹 Complexere IT

jobs.title: Senior QA Specialist
jobs.description: About us Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next! Mission of this role Thousands of rental companies run their business on Rentman, and many of them depend on it talking smoothly to the rest of their stack: accounting packages, webshops, calendars, and our public API. When an integration breaks, invoices don’t sync, bookings go missing, and customers notice fast. As Senior QA Specialist for the Integrations team, you make sure every release reaches those customers without regressions. You own the team’s test strategy and lead the move from manual release-day testing to an automated, shift-left suite. This is a role with real ownership: you shape how the team thinks about quality, and you grow the practice as our integrations platform grows. Own material requirements for normal operation, abuse, and failure cases, including thermal runaway, fire, venting, crash, vibration, humidity, and fluid exposure. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent
